blocker: external_study_unavailable: no local study is both unseen by the decision work and compatible with MAESTRO's mechanism-discrimination episodes (a cell-line x time x dose menu, replicate-based detection and QC, and at least six labelled identities per pool class). The one fully compatible study, LINCS L1000 Phase II (GEO GSE70138), is not local; fetching it needs the owner's approval.

requirements.identity: exact compound identity (InChIKey) so compound and scaffold overlap with the development reference library can be excluded
requirements.labels: single-mechanism annotation from a source fixed before the run (Repurposing Hub 2020-03-24 exact joins, as in development)
requirements.class_depth: at least six labelled identities per pool class and two with a detected response (the block-4 L1000 pool rule)
requirements.menu: at least two actions per episode with a registered cost; ideally the development menu (A549, MCF7, PC3, VCAP at 10 uM, 6 h and 24 h) so the frozen fixed sequence and assay-day costs apply unchanged
requirements.detection_and_qc: replicate structure (two or more wells on two or more plates) and vehicle controls per line and time
requirements.independence: plates and batches disjoint from development; compounds whose InChIKey block or Murcko scaffold is in the development reference library excluded
requirements.representation: the same profile representation as the frozen development reference library, or a representation change pre-registered and applied to development before the external freeze

recommended_external_study.representation_caveat: the development L1000 profiles are the subset48 condition-mean cache, whose runner is missing; Phase II cannot be put in that representation exactly. Recommended: re-derive the development tiers from GSE92742_Broad_LINCS_Level5_COMPZ.MODZ_n473647x12328.gctx.gz (20G) with the same signature-level representation, re-run and re-freeze the development ladder, and only then read Phase II. Alternative: rebuild condition means from Level 3 in both releases (49G and 13G).
